name: Seerr
desc: Find and request movies and shows for Plex

changes.summary: Finds your Seerr server on the network by itself
points: The first time you open Seerr it searches the network (Overseerr, Jellyseerr and Seerr on port 5055), so you only have to pick the server
Find server on the network is also on the setup screen and in the Seerr menu
